title: Sentinel: adaptive multi-tenant SSE/WSS load harness with token-rate drift detection
creator: Asha Patel
description: Implement 'Sentinel', a new load testing harness that emulates multi-tenant SSE and WebSocket chat/completions traffic and detects token-rate and p95 latency drift/regressions against historical baselines. The harness will simulate realistic session patterns (burstiness, think-time, sequence-length distributions), support KV cache warmup and eviction modeling, and exercise smart routing fallbacks. It must produce telemetry compatible with existing Console dashboards and trigger regression alerts when token/sec or p95 deviates beyond configured SLO windows.
acceptance_criteria: Simulate at least 10k concurrent virtual sessions across multiple tenant weights with configurable churn patterns
Emit telemetry metrics tokens_per_sec, p95_ms, p99_ms, connection_acquire_ms, kv_cache_hit_rate, error_rate to prometheus/Grafana
Detect drifts: automatic baseline comparison with configurable threshold (default 10% tokens/sec or 15% p95) and open an incident/alert when triggered
Support both SSE and WebSocket protocols with code paths for connection multiplexing and backpressure
Provide a reproducible regression run that locks model variant, seed, and sequence-length distribution and uploads result artifact to CI (linkable)
Integrate with PagerDuty and post a summary on Slack channel #perf-alerts when regression is detected
steps: 1) Design API for scenario definitions (tenant_mix, seq_len_dist, token_rate_target, cache_profile)
2) Implement client pools for SSE and WS with token-level pacing and jitter
3) Add KV-cache simulator that models prefix reuse and TTL-based eviction
4) Instrument metrics and expose /metrics endpoint compatible with Prometheus
5) Implement baseline store and drift-detector job with simple statistical tests (bootstrap + median ratio)
6) Wire alerting to Slack/PagerDuty and store run artifacts in GCS under gs://redwood-perf/sentinel/runs/
7) Run staged e2e against staging runtime and validate alerts and dashboards
